name: Raiden Kaname
source:
Someone who's accompanying you during your stay in the village. Even though she appears masculine, sword techniques she unleashes are powerful enough to make one tremble.
Her appearance can be intimidating at first glance, yet beneath that she's friendly and considerate towards everyone, yet there is something uncanny about her, showing no openings.
